source:
A lazy, sheltered man with a twisted worldview. On the surface, he was just another salaryman, but beneath it all, an intense resentment toward society brewed within him. Driven to the edge, he finds his way to an abandoned highway—an infamous destination—ready to end his journey.

That is, until he meets a mysterious girl.

"Shall we die together?"

She presents a device called the "Euthanasia Wave." But rather than ending his own life, the man finds a new purpose: to use this machine to change the path of those longing for an end by spreading a wave of euthanasia.

Yet, his moral compass has already broken beyond repair...

A visual novel that will challenge your perspective on humanity.

[From [url=https://enseibito.itch.io/the-root-of-our-madness]itch.io[/url]]
